candidates.explanation: The comment says the signing secret embeds the current password hash so that links stop verifying once the password changes. The code appends `user.email` instead of `user.password`. The email doesn't change when the password is reset, so the secret stays the same. The JWT keeps verifying until it expires, and the same link can be used again to set another password.

fix.description: Build the secret from the user's current password hash: `${forgotSecret}${user.password ?? ''}`. Make sure the user object passed in (from findById/findByEmail) includes the password hash. Alternatively, store a one-time token or a version/jti and invalidate it after use.
